terms.gloss: a discovery, an invention: something found out
evidence: Ov. Met. 1.521: inventum medicīna meum est
terms.comment: What has been found out or devised, a discovery and an invention alike: Zeno’s doctrines, Apollo’s medicine.

terms.gloss: the finding out, discovering (the act or the faculty)
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 1.61: illa vīs quae investīgat occulta, quae inventiō atque excōgitātiō dīcitur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: In rhetoric, the finding of arguments, the first part of the art.

sources: Lewis & Short: inventum · Lewis & Short: inventio
